data.why: The repo ships a built-in sample workbook (大循环/小循环/点循环/AHP矩阵 sheets) for the /api/compute endpoint; a stub hydro_api_helpers module is seeded at repo root because api.py imports it from a private path (~/Dev/devtools/lib) that doesn't exist outside the author's machine.

goals: Run the built-in sample data through the AHP+CRITIC combined-weighting and TOPSIS pipeline to get a baseline efficiency ranking
Upload a custom industrial-park water-use workbook (大循环/小循环/点循环-年度/AHP判断矩阵 sheets) and compute its indicator matrix
Adjust the alpha parameter to see how shifting weight between the subjective (AHP) and objective (CRITIC) methods changes enterprise rankings
Check the AHP consistency ratio (CR) returned in the response to confirm the judgment matrix is usable
Download the generated Excel report (indicator matrix, weights, layered scores, TOPSIS ranking) for further analysis
Compare the JSON-formatted output (format=json) to inspect per-indicator weight charts and water-efficiency grade distribution across enterprises

review.summary: The tree correctly describes this as reclaimed-water efficiency scoring with AHP+CRITIC weighting, alpha sensitivity and TOPSIS grading. The cited screens I opened support the values given, apart from the partial-support gaps noted under evidence. It needs fixing before filing: drop the health/meta plumbing phase and add the three-level scoring the README lists, plus the minor label and evidence fixes listed.
